arguments.query: SELECT o.order_id,o.order_ts,o.status,o.channel,i.quantity,i.unit_price_cents,p.list_price_twd FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id WHERE o.channel='store' LIMIT 8

SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(t.amt)/100.0, SUM(t.amt)/100.0/COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT o.order_id, SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents) amt FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.channel='store' AND o.status IN (1,2,3) AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours')>='2025-01-01' AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours')<'2025-07-01' GROUP BY o.order_id) t
